svg.title: Modeer Almalaaeb — Six core models + Cup
svg.desc: Seven editable entity cards: User, Sport, Room, Membership, Message, Group and Cup. Thirteen lettered relationship groups show foreign-key references; several letters group multiple user references. Room slot layouts and cup fixtures are embedded JSON data, not additional models. Sports news comes from an external API, with no News model.
svg.text: PK = primary key · FK = foreign key · NULL = optional parent · each referenced parent may have many records.

player, organizer or admin · active or suspended
